credits.title: The Ideas
credits.overview: A woman creates fake dating profiles until she runs into one of the men she has deceived.

credits.title: Sad Jokes
credits.overview: Director Joseph is working through a new idea for a film and the breakup with his ex-boyfriend Marc. At the same time Sonya, the mother of his son Pino, is suffering from a depression that increasingly tears her from her life.

credits.title: Fallet - Hagamanen
credits.overview: At the beginning of the 2000s, Hagamannen of Umeå was one of the country's most feared serial rapist. For a period of eight years, he raped eight women resulting in one of the largest criminal investigations in Swedish history.
